name: langgraph
description: LangGraph agent 经 A2A 官方样例 a2aproject/a2a-samples（samples/python/agents/langgraph）暴露，JSON-RPC 端点与 Agent Card 同源。Windows 用 PowerShell 安装 uv 并显式绑定 --host localhost --port 10000。

metadata.install: git clone https://github.com/a2aproject/a2a-samples.git; cd a2a-samples\samples\python\agents\langgraph; powershell -c "irm https://astral.sh/uv/install.ps1 | iex"; uv sync
